example.title: Hilton Los Angeles / San Gabriel (1990s), Valley Boulevard
example.place: San Gabriel, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1990s Mediterranean-style hotel on a commercial boulevard: a stepped mass of cream stucco rising to ten storeys, red-tile roofs over arched top-floor windows, green-lit signage, and a ground floor of restaurants and shops behind a row of palms. Four photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
